subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT included in the Energy Conservation (Amendment) Bill, 2022?

options.text: Decision to expand the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) governing council
Setting up of a carbon credit trading scheme
A non-fossil-fuel mandate for designated consumers
Reducing the purview of energy consumption standards

solution:
The correct answer is __**Reducing the purview of energy consumption standards.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Energy Conservation (Amendment) Bill, 2022:-**

 
 
• **It aims to strengthen the regulatory framework for energy efficiency and conservation in India, not reduce the purview of energy consumption standards. **
 
• In fact, the bill expands the scope of energy consumption standards by empowering the central government to specify energy efficiency standards for a wider range of appliances and equipment.
 
• **Decision to expand the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) governing council:-**
 
 
• The bill does expand the BEE governing council to include more representatives from industry, academia, and non-governmental organizations.
 
 
 
• **Setting up of a carbon credit trading scheme:-**
 
 
• The bill introduces a carbon credit trading scheme to promote the use of renewable energy and reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
 
 
 
• **Non-fossil-fuel mandate for designated consumers:-**
 
 
• The bill mandates that designated consumers, such as industries, commercial buildings, and the transport sector, must meet a minimum share of their energy consumption from non-fossil sources.
